summary: The note is a short fragment from the Wikipedia list of European Cup and UEFA Champions League finals. Its visible content is an infobox-style summary: the competition was founded in 1955, is run by UEFA for Europe, has 32 teams in the group stage and 2 finalists, and Real Madrid is both the current champion with its 12th title and the most successful club with 12 titles. The page also references the 2017-18 UEFA Champions League season. The rest of the list of finals is not included in the note.
one_line: Infobox summary of the European Cup and UEFA Champions League finals list, covering the competition's 1955 founding, format, and Real Madrid's record of 12 titles.
key_facts: The European Cup / Champions League trophy belongs to a competition founded in 1955.
The competition's region is Europe, governed by UEFA.
The Champions League group stage has 32 teams.
The final is contested by 2 teams (finalists).
The current champions of the competition are Real Madrid, which won its 12th title.
Real Madrid is the most successful club in the competition, with 12 titles.
The note references the 2017-18 UEFA Champions League season.
The note is a Wikipedia list titled 'List of European Cup and UEFA Champions League finals'.
